verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Weave captures function inputs, outputs, code and metadata through weave.op. No item mentions logging images, audio, files or other multimodal payloads inside traces. Generic input/output capture is adjacent and does not show multimodal support, and the axis clearly applies to a tracing product.

support.subject: As a developer, I can capture multimodal payloads (images, audio, files) inside my traces
